caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white and depicts a lidded tankard with detailed ornamental features. The main object, the tankard, is cylindrical with a wide base that narrows slightly toward the top, and it has a domed lid with a small decorative finial. The central body of the tankard features elaborate etched decorations, including a central shield with interlaced initials (“R L”), surrounded by garland-like drapery and leaf patterns. Above the shield is a bow and additional swag detail. In the top left corner, an enlarged and detailed view of the tankard’s ornate handle is provided, showing a stylized dragon or serpent head and scrollwork. In the top right corner, there is a profile outline of the complete tankard, showing its side view with the handle and lid. The drawing is executed with fine lines and shading to suggest the reflective metallic surface of the tankard, and the background is left plain, emphasizing the objects.
title: Silver Tankard
